definitions: The process of detecting and correcting (or removing) corrupt or inaccurate records from a record set, table, or database.
The act of identifying incomplete, incorrect, inaccurate, irrelevant, etc., parts of the data and then replacing, modifying, or deleting the dirty data.
examples: Effective data cleansing improves data quality.
The project involved extensive data cleansing.
Data cleansing is crucial for accurate analytics.
